brief.aim: Table is the Cleveland heart-disease cohort assembled to predict angiographic disease presence; heart_disease_binary (164/139) is the clear two-level outcome, so binary classification with a single target and no group/time structure. The 0-4 severity column num is the raw grading from which the binary flag was recoded, so it is a leakage suspect and excluded from features.
brief.repeated_subjects: None evident; no subject/record key column repeats across rows.
